title: Finite machine in code normal form
statement: For any finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet with exactly one work tape, there is a code-normal-form machine with $m+1$ states, where $m$ is one less than the number of states of the original machine. Its state set is identified with the original state set by a bijection, and its transitions and initial state are transported along that bijection.
hypotheses_covered: The machine is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols.
The machine has exactly one work tape.
